properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs step_reading, concluded_by_steps, objections_within). An `assumed` premise no step anywhere discharges that reads refuted makes its step not hold (`rests_on_refuted_suppositions`); the claim reads "rests on the refuted supposition(s) S"; an objection derived so reads `answered`. Only suppositions no step discharges, so a reductio's is never caught. The capstone's H-agile, derived under S2 after U1 refuted S2, no longer reads holds.
